verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a public REST API, for example `POST https://api.helicone.ai/v1/request/query`, with a live OpenAPI spec at docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json. Its core gateway is driven programmatically through an OpenAI-compatible API, and a community user confirms exporting all requests. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage beyond request querying (e.g., managing prompts, webhooks, alerts or sessions via REST), and independent hands-on corroboration of the management API's breadth.
